config_yaml:
# Phase 6 performance benchmarks (ADR-020 windows, ADR-021 prompts).
# Every run embeds this file and its SHA-256 in its results.
# Point timings were revised after the AWQ probe (probe-20260923T213438Z):
# E2E p50 2.42 s at c=1 and 34.4 s at c=256. Rule (ADR-020): warmup_s >=
# ramp_s + one expected E2E, with the other systems' E2E extrapolated.
name: phase6-bench
gpu: L40S
model:
  id: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
  revision: b968826d9c46dd6066d109eabc6255188de91218
quantization_config: phase4_quantize.yaml  # where Phase 4 wrote AWQ/GPTQ

# The checkpoints must match the files Phase 4 produced, and Phase 5 measured
# accuracy on, byte for byte (sha256), before any GPU time is spent.
expected_checkpoints:
  bf16: results/quantization/phase4/download-20260923T102838Z/manifest.json
  awq: results/quantization/phase4/quantize-awq-20260923T103930Z/summary.json
  gptq: results/quantization/phase4/quantize-gptq-20260923T121835Z/summary.json

prompts:  # W1: exact 512-token windows of WikiText-103 (ADR-021)
  dataset: Salesforce/wikitext
  revision: b08601e04326c79dfdd32d625aee71d232d685c3
  files:
    - wikitext-103-raw-v1/train-00000-of-00002.parquet
    - wikitext-103-raw-v1/train-00001-of-00002.parquet
  input_tokens: 512
  count: 50000  # > the most requests any lifetime can send (~25k planned)
  oversample: 1.5  # sample from the first 75,000 windows
  seed: 20260923

workload:
  input_tokens: 512
  output_tokens: 256
  seed: 0
  client_processes: 2  # ADR-013
  # In-Modal capacity (loadtest-check-20260923T205147Z). A point receiving more
  # than a third of this fails ADR-005's 3x headroom rule and is not accepted.
  validated_client_chunks_per_s: 9124.1
  idle_timeout_s: 900

vllm:
  health_timeout_s: 900
  engine_args:
    - --dtype
    - bfloat16
    - --max-model-len
    - "1024"  # 512 + 256 = 768 tokens per request
    - --gpu-memory-utilization
    - "0.90"
    - --max-num-seqs
    - "256"
    - --seed
    - "0"
    - --no-enable-prefix-caching  # unique prompts and no cache reuse (SPEC §6)
    - --generation-config
    - vllm  # ignore the checkpoint's sampling defaults
    - --disable-uvicorn-access-log
    # No --enforce-eager: performance runs use CUDA graphs.

hf:
  dtype: bfloat16
  attn_implementation: sdpa
  health_timeout_s: 600
  batch_wait_ms: 50
  oom_candidates: [8, 16, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128]

# Steady-state points (ADR-020): users start staggered over ramp_s; the
# window opens at warmup_s (>= ramp_s + one expected E2E).
points:
  c1: {concurrency: 1, ramp_s: 0, warmup_s: 15, window_s: 120, timeout_s: 600}
  c4: {concurrency: 4, ramp_s: 5, warmup_s: 20, window_s: 120, timeout_s: 600}
  c16: {concurrency: 16, ramp_s: 8, warmup_s: 25, window_s: 120, timeout_s: 600}
  c64: {concurrency: 64, ramp_s: 15, warmup_s: 40, window_s: 180, timeout_s: 600}
  c128: {concurrency: 128, ramp_s: 20, warmup_s: 50, window_s: 180, timeout_s: 600}
  c256: {concurrency: 256, ramp_s: 30, warmup_s: 80, window_s: 180, timeout_s: 600}
  # --max-num-seqs 16 queues 240 users: E2E ~70 s (~4.4 s per request, 16 at a time).
  c256-mb16: {concurrency: 256, ramp_s: 30, warmup_s: 120, window_s: 180, timeout_s: 900}
  probe-c1: {concurrency: 1, ramp_s: 0, warmup_s: 10, window_s: 60, timeout_s: 600}
  probe-c256: {concurrency: 256, ramp_s: 30, warmup_s: 60, window_s: 90, timeout_s: 600}
  # HF: naive queues every request behind the others (~7 s each, estimated),
  # so E2E grows with concurrency; static batches of B.
  hf-c4: {concurrency: 4, ramp_s: 5, warmup_s: 40, window_s: 120, timeout_s: 900}
  hf-c16: {concurrency: 16, ramp_s: 8, warmup_s: 125, window_s: 180, timeout_s: 900}
  hf-cB: {concurrency: B, ramp_s: 10, warmup_s: 60, window_s: 180, timeout_s: 900}
  hf-c2B: {concurrency: 2B, ramp_s: 20, warmup_s: 90, window_s: 180, timeout_s: 900}

# One server lifetime each. "-r2"/"-r3" repeat a point in the same lifetime
# (headline repeats; median of 3 with the sweep's own run).
lifetimes:
  probe:
    variant: awq
    points: [probe-c1, probe-c256]
  bf16:
    variant: bf16
    points: [c1, c4, c16, c64, c128, c256, c1-r2, c256-r2, c1-r3, c256-r3]
  awq:
    variant: awq
    points: [c1, c4, c16, c64, c128, c256, c1-r2, c256-r2, c1-r3, c256-r3]
    cross_check:  # vllm bench serve at matching settings (random 512/256 prompts)
      - {concurrency: 1, num_prompts: 30}
      - {concurrency: 64, num_prompts: 640}
      - {concurrency: 256, num_prompts: 2048}
  gptq:
    variant: gptq
    points: [c1, c4, c16, c64, c128, c256]
  maxbatch-16:
    variant: awq
    extra_engine_args: [--max-num-seqs, "16"]
    points: [c256-mb16]
  maxbatch-64:
    variant: awq
    extra_engine_args: [--max-num-seqs, "64"]
    points: [c256]
  hf-naive:
    variant: bf16
    engine: hf
    mode: naive
    points: [c1, hf-c4, hf-c16, hf-c16-r2, hf-c16-r3]
  hf-static:
    variant: bf16
    engine: hf
    mode: static
    points: [c4, c16, hf-cB, hf-c2B, hf-c2B-r2, hf-c2B-r3]
